Container.Name: KeepLocal
Container.Overview: KeepLocal is a self-hosted, multi-user notes application with checklists, tags, colors, archives, collaboration, private uploads, five themes, a responsive PWA, and optional local Whisper transcription. The all-in-one image includes MongoDB, the API, AI service, and web client. Persist both configured data paths and provide a unique JWT secret before first start.
Container.Requires: A unique JWT_SECRET containing at least 32 random characters is required.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the KeepLocal web interface.

Config.Name: MongoDB Data
Config.Description: Persistent MongoDB data. Back up this path before updates.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Persistent private note uploads. Back up this path together with MongoDB.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Recovery points written by scripts/backup.js. Without this mount they live in the container layer and die with the next update.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Required: generate at least 32 random characters, for example with openssl rand -hex 48. Never reuse the example from documentation.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Exact comma-separated browser origins. Use the public HTTPS URL when a reverse proxy is used; wildcards are rejected.

Config.Name: Client URL
Config.Description: Exact browser origin used for OAuth redirects. Match Allowed Origins.

Config.Name: CSRF Secret
Config.Description: Optional independent CSRF signing key with at least 32 random characters. JWT_SECRET is used when omitted.

Config.Name: JWT Lifetime
Config.Description: Session token lifetime, for example 7d or 12h.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Leave empty for automatic HTTPS detection. Set true only when KeepLocal is reached through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy Hops
Config.Description: Use 1 for direct access and 2 when an external reverse proxy sits in front of the built-in Nginx.

Config.Name: Whisper Model
Config.Description: Bundled transcription model: tiny is the fastest and lowest-memory default.

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Keep production for normal deployments.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Where scripts/backup.js writes recovery points. Must be the mounted Backups path.

Config.Name: Uploads Directory
Config.Description: Uploads root containing images/ and temp/. Must be the mounted Uploads path.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: error, warn, info or debug. Empty keeps the default (info).

Config.Name: Log Format
Config.Description: Set json for structured logs with request ids. Empty keeps human-readable lines.

Config.Name: Require AI For Ready
Config.Description: Set true to make an unreachable Whisper service fail the readiness probe. Empty keeps transcription optional.

Config.Name: Health Details
Config.Description: Set true to expose internal paths and driver errors on /api/health/ready. Leave empty in production.

Config.Name: AI Service Token
Config.Description: Shared bearer secret between API and Whisper. Empty generates one per container start.

Config.Name: Transcriptions Per Hour
Config.Description: Per-user budget. Empty keeps the default (10).

Config.Name: Transcriptions Per Day
Config.Description: Per-user budget. Empty keeps the default (60).

Config.Name: AI Health Timeout Ms
Config.Description: Readiness probe timeout for the Whisper service in milliseconds. Empty keeps 2000.

Config.Name: Link Previews Per Minute
Config.Description: Per-user budget for link previews. Empty keeps the default (30).

Config.Name: Concurrent Transcriptions
Config.Description: Keep equal to the Whisper worker count (1). Empty keeps the default.

Config.Name: Trash Retention Days
Config.Description: Days before the janitor deletes trashed notes and their files. Empty keeps 30.

Config.Name: Storage Janitor Interval Hours
Config.Description: How often expired trash, orphaned images and temp uploads are cleaned. 0 disables it; empty keeps 6.

Config.Name: Transcription Minutes Per Day
Config.Description: Per-user daily audio-minute budget. Empty keeps the default (120).

Config.Name: Upload Quota MB
Config.Description: Storage budget per account in MB. 0 keeps accounts unlimited; the server rejects uploads with 413 once exceeded.

Config.Name: Backup Min Free MB
Config.Description: A backup run is refused below this many MB of free space on the backup volume. Empty keeps 500.

Config.Name: Health Min Free MB
Config.Description: Below this many MB free on the data volume /api/health reports disk warnings. Empty keeps 500.

Config.Name: Health Disk Fatal
Config.Description: Set true to also fail the readiness probe when free space runs out. Empty keeps false.
